{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

""" def build_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, details_of_event: str, when_event_is: str, extra_event_info: str ) -> str: """ Construct a secure, sanitized HTML invitation. All user supplied strings are escaped to prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74). The resulting HTML is safe for rendering in browsers. Args: title_of_event: Name or heading of the event. details_of_event: Extensive description (may contain newlines). when_event_is: Date of the event. extra_event_info: Any additional notes or instructions. """ # Escape all inputs to neutralize special characters safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(details_of_event, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(when_event_is, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(extra_event_info, quote=True).replace('\n', '
